digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 41
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Pickering SDK drops an old Python
items.summary: Pickering SDK 7.0 needs Python 3.11 or newer. Python 3.9 support ends with this release.

items.title: Lornwick Agents add tool call budgets
items.summary: Lornwick Agents add budgets that cap how many tool calls one task may make. A task that hits its budget stops and returns what it has.
items.whyItMatters: A task that hits its budget stops and returns what it has.

items.title: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search
items.summary: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search that combines keyword and vector scores. Filters run before scoring, so results stay fast on large collections.
items.whyItMatters: Filters run before scoring, so results stay fast on large collections.

sources.title: Pickering SDK drops an old Python
sources.summary: Pickering SDK 7.0 needs Python 3.10 or newer. Python 3.9 support ends with this release. Type hints are now complete.

sources.title: Lornwick Agents add tool call budgets
sources.summary: Lornwick Agents add budgets that cap how many tool calls one task may make. A task that hits its budget stops and returns what it has. Budgets can be set per team in the admin console.

sources.title: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search
sources.summary: Ormsby Vector adds filtered hybrid search that combines keyword and vector scores. Filters run before scoring, so results stay fast on large collections. Result pages can be fetched with a stable cursor.
